opening.argument: The speaker promotes Future Money as "an awesome program" and presents it as a cryptocurrency course, while identifying "Craig Grant is my sponsor" and inviting viewers to join. The description then directs viewers to Bitconnect and a Future Money opportunity page using the same referral-style identifier, tying the educational pitch to linked opportunities rather than an isolated discussion of cryptocurrency. On screen, FutureMoney.io certification and a Sponsor section bearing craigrant reinforce that connection. A displayed BCC receiving address further shows participation infrastructure, though it is not linked to joining. The evidence does not establish referral compensation, a required payment, promised returns, or an audience transaction; the speaker instead says joining is free to learn. Those limitations narrow the claim, but the sponsored invitation and matched referral links establish a recruitment-oriented cryptocurrency opportunity consistent with tiered-matrix promotion.
